steps.title: Welcome to Skirmish MVP
steps.instruction:
This is a small RTS skirmish. Your goal is to destroy the enemy Command Hub.

You will:
1. Read credits and power.
2. Build a Power Generator and Barracks.
3. Queue a Rifle Squad.
4. Move and attack with your squad.

Start by clicking your Command Hub.

steps.title: Pan and zoom the battlefield
steps.instruction: Use WASD or right-drag to pan. Use +/- or the mouse wheel to zoom. Try moving the map now.

steps.title: Inspect Command Hub
steps.instruction: Click your Command Hub (blue base). Read the inspector — it shows health, status, and plain-English role text.

steps.title: Read credits and power
steps.instruction: Check the summary panel for your credits and power supply/demand. You need power before most buildings can operate.

steps.title: Build Power Generator
steps.instruction: Click Power Generator in the build menu (or press 1). Click a green hex near your hub to place it.

steps.title: Build Barracks
steps.instruction: Click Barracks in the build menu (or press 2). Place it within your build radius.

steps.title: Queue Rifle Squad
steps.instruction: Click Queue Rifle Squad (or press Q). Then click your Barracks to add the squad to its production queue.

steps.title: Select your squad
steps.instruction: When your Rifle Squad appears, click it on the map. The inspector shows health, status, and orders.

steps.title: Move your squad
steps.instruction: With your squad selected, click an empty hex to move there. The squad advances automatically while the game is running.

steps.title: Attack the enemy
steps.instruction: Select your squad and click an enemy unit or building to attack. Destroy the enemy Command Hub to win.

steps.title: Win the skirmish
steps.instruction: Keep attacking until the enemy Command Hub is destroyed. Victory appears in the objective panel.
